notes: Single university-level page (AI Academic Misconduct, OSRR); both coders marked it delegates. Disagreements on matched units: modality must vs should on the two 'Faculty members are expected to' duties (resolved to must, since 'expected to' is a duty unlike 'encouraged to'); modality informs vs should on 'Students should not be expected to guess' (informs, a principle); actor student vs all on the unauthorized-AI definition (student); actor and modality on the student-response-opportunity line and actor on the conduct-process line (admin, informs, since they describe what the office provides); policy type P35 vs UNCOVERED on question banks and randomized testing (P35, same list as other assessment-design items). Only-A units (review expectations at semester start; degree-value rationale) and all eight only-B units (discuss before assignments, prevent-misunderstandings rationale, syllabus consequences, types of assistance, tools evolve, opportunity to respond, student notified, peers and trust) are real statements in the source and were kept. Anchor-only differences on the same passage were not counted as disagreements.
